description: What the validation-skeptic-agent applies to every candidate. The verdict is KILLED unless the canonical statistical gate passes AND every required adversarial check is reported passed WITH a measured value. The sha256 of this file is bound into every pre-registration; a review under a different hash is refused, which is what 'thresholds frozen before final evaluation' means in code.
version_2_2_changes: cost: the universal economic qualification gate is no longer a raw one-way TURNOVER scalar. It is an ANNUALISED COST-BUDGET computed from the cell's own frozen cost model and rebalance frequency (alpha_agent.r61.cost_budget). The 0.40 scalar was horizon-blind and cost-blind: it priced a liquid futures book at a mid-cap equity cost and killed two of R60's four non-equity cells before any return was scored, for money futures do not spend.

diagnostic: raw one-way turnover is still measured and still reported, and gates NOTHING. max_turnover_per_decision_one_side is retained ONLY as a labelled diagnostic so a reader can see what the retired gate would have said.

fail-closed: a cost budget that cannot be computed - a frozen cost model stating a per-instrument vector with no measured effective rate supplied - is COST_BUDGET_NOT_EVALUABLE, and that is a FAILED machine check. A cost that could not be computed was not paid by nobody; it was not checked.

pre-measurement halts: a cell that stops before any return exists is settled through pipeline.record_pre_measurement_halt, which may write DATA_HOLD or REJECTED and may NEVER write NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE. A cell that computed no return has said nothing about alpha.

drawdown: strategy drawdown and excess drawdown are two CONCEPTS with one owner (alpha_agent.r61.drawdown). The risk agent rules on the canonical concept and a surface may not read a drawdown that was never measured.
version_2_1_changes: materiality: the floor now travels WITH the metric, and EVERY reported materiality metric is graded against its own floor (2.0 could read the metric from net_sharpe and the floor from ann_net_excess, comparing a Sharpe to 0.015)

placebo: the comparison is COST-NEUTRAL by construction - the placebo is re-simulated with its cost scaled to the candidate's realised drag, so the margin measures predictive content and not the candidate's lower turnover
reveal: D, V and L are revealed SEQUENTIALLY and a later layer is never measured until the earlier one earned it
burden: the generative (machine-representation) prior is charged whenever the candidate is declared generative-search OR its attributed family is itself a machine-representation family

canonical_statistical_gate.rule: The skeptic DELEGATES the statistical verdict. It never re-implements it and never relaxes it.

inherited_thresholds.source: alpha_agent.r59 (inherited from R57/R58 so results stay comparable)
inherited_thresholds.max_annualized_cost_drag_derivation: 2.0 x materiality_floor_ann_net_excess (0.015). A cell may spend on trading at most twice what it must ultimately deliver net; at the ceiling the required GROSS premium is 4.5%/yr merely to reach the 1.5%/yr floor the candidate has to clear anyway. The multiple is a declared appetite fixed against a constant frozen long before this release and for an unrelated reason. No measured return enters the derivation, and it was NOT chosen by looking at what r60_05, r60_07 or r60_08 produced.
inherited_thresholds.max_annualized_cost_drag_formula: one_way_turnover * 2 * cost_per_side * rebalances_per_year + additional_ann_cost_drag, where rebalances_per_year = 252 / rebalance_interval_sessions, cost_per_side is a RATE on traded notional (25 bp/side = 0.0025), and additional_ann_cost_drag carries a dated-contract futures book's ROLL cost.
inherited_thresholds.max_annualized_cost_drag_continuity: Monthly equity at 25 bp/side sitting exactly on the RETIRED 0.40 scalar costs 0.40 x 2 x 0.0025 x 12 = 2.4%/yr, just inside this ceiling. The new gate agrees with the old one in the world the scalar was calibrated for and differs exactly where the scalar was blind: a different cost, or a different frequency.
inherited_thresholds.max_turnover_per_decision_one_side_statu: RETIRED AS A GATE IN SCHEMA 2.2 - DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Superseded by max_annualized_cost_drag. Reported so a reader can see what the retired gate would have said; nothing in the governed path may refuse a cell on it.

canonical_statistical_gate.materiality_rule: The floor travels WITH the metric: ann_net_excess is graded against materiality_floor_ann_net_excess and net_sharpe against materiality_floor_net_sharpe. A layer that reports BOTH is making two claims and must clear BOTH floors; validation is read on the SAME metrics as the lockbox, so the two layers can never be graded on different scales. A layer that reports NO materiality metric is not material.
canonical_statistical_gate.observation_rule: EFFECTIVE observations are used when the evaluator reports them; an overlapping-window book's raw period count is not its sample size.
canonical_statistical_gate.burden_rule: Every candidate is charged for its family's prior tests, for every settled agent experiment in the campaign, and for its own within-family multiplicity (a horizon sweep of four is four draws).
canonical_statistical_gate.generative_burden_rule: A candidate drawn from a generated or swept search space is ALSO charged the estate's prior machine-representation search in its asset class. The charge applies when the frozen pre-registration declares generative_search=true OR when the attributed family is itself a machine-representation family; the candidate's own family is never counted twice. Declaring generative_search is the director's call and it is FROZEN at pre-registration, never chosen at review time.

report_shape.evidence: artifact path or short statement, REQUIRED

adversarial_checks.unmeasured_rule: A check reported passed without a measured value counts as FAILED.

required.attack: every input was observable at the decision instant; fundamentals use filing availability, never period end; delisted names and expired contracts retained
the signal is unchanged when all data after t is destroyed; the return is realised strictly after t, from an executable entry
the candidate beats a COST-NEUTRAL permuted-signal placebo on the same panel by the pre-registered margin
the lockbox net result stays positive at twice the pre-registered cost
the effect is not produced by one subperiod, one instrument or one event
the realised decision-by-decision ordering is not a monotone re-expression of a settled hypothesis (rank fingerprint / |Spearman| >= 0.999)

machine_checked.rule: the submitted signal_sign equals the pre-registered expected_sign; computed by the pipeline, not reported by an agent
the submitted cost model equals the pre-registered cost model; computed by the pipeline

projected annualised cost drag <= max_annualized_cost_drag, computed by alpha_agent.r61.cost_budget from the cell's OWN frozen cost model and rebalance frequency; computed by the pipeline, never reported by an agent. A budget that cannot be computed is COST_BUDGET_NOT_EVALUABLE and FAILS - it fails closed, because a cost that was not checked was not met.

placebo.why: A permuted signal has no persistence, so it churns and pays MORE cost than the book it tests. Comparing the two on net therefore credits the candidate for trading less - a turnover difference, not predictive content. In 2.0 a high-turnover candidate could be beaten by its own placebo and a low-turnover one could clear the margin on cost alone.
placebo.rule: The placebo book is re-simulated with its cost scaled so its realised cost drag equals the candidate's. Only then is the margin applied, and only to metrics BOTH books report. A comparison whose cost drags do not match within cost_drag_tolerance is REFUSED, never passed.
placebo.permutation: the signal is permuted ACROSS the cross-section within each decision date, so the panel, the eligibility mask, the calendar and the gross exposure are identical and only the assignment of scores to instruments is destroyed

FUTURES_PER_MARKET.rule: preferred over the flat default wherever it is owned

outcome_mapping.SURVIVED: NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE until risk, meta and director have ruled; only director_clear writes QUALIFIED

sequential_reveal.rule: Discovery is measured first. Validation is measured ONLY if discovery advanced; the lockbox is measured ONLY if validation advanced. A candidate whose layers were not revealed in that order, or whose submitted layer statistics differ from the revealed ones, is refused - not killed on the numbers, refused as unmeasurable.
sequential_reveal.advance_test: the layer clears stage_advance_fraction_of_floor of its own metric's materiality floor, on every metric it reports, with at least one observation. This is deliberately WEAK: it decides only whether the estate has earned the right to LOOK at the next layer. The verdict remains the canonical statistical gate, and that gate still runs on the lockbox alone.
sequential_reveal.halt: A stage that does not advance SETTLES the experiment as NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE with the halting layer named. The lockbox is never computed, so it cannot be inspected, reported, quoted or re-used, and the experiment still counts to the search burden.
sequential_reveal.why: In 2.0 a signal agent measured D, V and L in one call and submitted all three together. The lockbox was therefore read by the researcher before the earlier layers had earned it, which is the contamination the three-way partition exists to prevent.

no_rescue_rule: A killed candidate is never re-run with altered parameters, a flipped sign, a different sample or a softer cost to obtain a pass. A control or by-product that looks strong is not adoptable; it needs a fresh human-authorised pre-registration on untouched data.
